BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.

5. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

10. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.

12. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   C. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
